notes.title: v3.9.0 fixed version has been released.
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where accounts migrated from other platforms to the Steam PC version were unable to retrieve currency information from the game server and were displayed with a reduced amount of currency in their possession. 
Please update your account by restarting the Steam client or checking the integrity of your game files.

We apologize for any inconvenience caused.

notes.title: SteamPC version is out now!
notes.notes:
Buriedbornes is a dungeon RPG released on Android/iOS in August 2016.
In response to numerous requests, we have now launched a Steam PC version.

After more than 6 years of updates already, the version is currently v3.9.0.
Please refer to [url=https://nussygame.com/tag/bb1-log/]this page[/url] for past updates.

We are very excited about the opportunity to expose even more people to the world of Buriedbornes through the Steam PC version.
We are currently developing a sequel, [url=https://nussygame.com/bb2/]Buriedbornes2[/url], so please look forward to that as well.

Please enjoy your blasphemous life!
